summary.text: Sharon Tomiko Santos is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 37-Position 1 since 1999, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Kelabe Tewolde.

paragraphs.text: Sharon Tomiko Santos earned a B.A. from The Evergreen State College in 1985 and an M.A. from Northeastern University in 1988.

She has experience in nonprofit management and fundraising, including as a gifts manager for the Seattle Chinatown International District Preservation and Development Authority and as executive director of the Institute for Global Security Studies, and she has also worked in retail banking.
Santos was previously an advisor for the Washington State Democrats and served on the Rules Committee for the Democratic National Committee in 2004.
